hook: My friend said 우리는 깐부잖아 and took my chicken

beats.speaker: learner
beats.text: My friend said 우리는 깐부잖아 and walked off with my chicken.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.text: Netflix said it means "we're friends, right?"

beats.speaker: tutor
beats.text: Not quite. 우리는 is "as for us".

beats.speaker: tutor
beats.text: 깐부 is kids' slang for your marble partner. You share everything.

beats.speaker: tutor
beats.text: And 잖아 means "you know". It reminds you of a promise.

beats.speaker: tutor
beats.text: Try it: 내일 시험이잖아. The test is tomorrow, you know!

beats.speaker: learner
beats.text: Paste any line into Hanbok for a breakdown like this.
